---
name: Commercial licensing inquiry
about: Ask ard12 about permission for commercial use of MCPTracer.
title: "Commercial licensing inquiry"
---

Submitting this inquiry does not grant permission. Commercial use requires an
explicit written grant from ard12. This is a public issue: do not include
credentials, customer data, personal contact details you do not want public,
or confidential terms. You can request a private discussion instead.

## Intended use

Describe the business or project and how you want to use MCPTracer.

## Version and distribution

Which version or commit? Is this internal use, a hosted service, client work,
or redistribution? Include only information you are comfortable making public.

## Scope

Which organization or party needs permission, and what deployment scope or
duration do you need? You may defer confidential details to a private channel.

## Attribution

Describe where MCPTracer and ard12 will be credited, or ask to discuss the
attribution requirements for your use.
